# BurgerAPI - Bun-native API Framework

> BurgerAPI is a Bun-first, WinterCG-compatible API framework with file-based routing, six lifecycle hooks, plugins, providers, Standard Schema (Zod) validation, automatic OpenAPI generation, and WebSocket support.

**Current release:** `burger-api` and `@burger-api/cli` ship `1.0.0-beta` (public beta, not yet recommended for production). The previous stable line is `0.9.x`: pin `burger-api@0.9.7` and `@burger-api/cli@0.9.9`. Full notes: https://burger-api.com/blog/burger-api-v1.0.0-beta-release
